build_directory_file_structure: build a Directory file structure representation from a list of file paths with include and exclude glob patterns
create_directory_add_file: create a Directory node and add a file by specifying its path relative to the root directory
test_directory_has_file: test whether a Directory contains a specified file path using the has_file method
summarize_directory_tree: summarize a Directory file structure as a printable tree with indented branches showing directories and files
refactor_directory_from_list: refactor a list of file paths into a hierarchical Directory structure using _create_directory_from_file_list with glob filtering
